items.title: Abstract Flower Silhouette DXF Panel for Minimalist Doors
items.description: A single stylized flower with rounded petals and a tall stem fills the panel in bold negative space, framed by soft cloud-like top edges. The simplified, sculptural silhouette suits minimalist front doors and modern garden gates.

items.title: Circular Flower Lattice DXF Pattern for Elegant Screens
items.description: Rows of layered circles interlock to form eight-petal flower medallions at each junction, producing an elegant, evenly spaced lattice. The consistent circular rhythm suits both formal and modern interiors.
